name: Mullen & Mullen Law Firm
about: Mullen & Mullen has practised in Dallas since 1982 and names three attorneys: two Mullens and a senior associate. Its verified listing in this market is the Frisco office.

It is the only firm in this ranking that claims a lower contingency rate than its competitors rather than simply no fee unless it wins, and it says a client can text the legal team directly at any hour. It publishes neither the rate itself nor any case results.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Franchise Taxpayers (data.texas.gov 9cir-efmm), published as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, which carries the Secretary of State file number, charter date and status and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed. The franchise tax does not reach a sole proprietorship or a general partnership, so this register can confirm an entity and cannot rule one out.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 3 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 68 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2003-09-18, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
